description: Surface a failed plan-approval branch creation instead of silently flipping the phase to 'implementing' with no cam/* branch.

userStories.title: Surface failed plan-approval branch creation instead of silently entering 'implementing'
userStories.description: As the operator driving the plan-approval gate, I need an approved plan whose branch/commit sequence fails to surface the failure (notification + durable log) instead of silently flipping the loop into 'implementing' with no cam/* branch, so a botched checkout-B/commit no longer strands the loop in an impossible state.
acceptanceCriteria: makePlanApprovalResolver's 'approve' arm returns 'implementing' ONLY when proceedBranchFn reports the cam/* branch was actually created; when it reports failure the resolver surfaces the failure via notifyFn and returns a phase that is NOT 'implementing' (fails safe to 'idle', mirroring the reject/default arms). [oracle: bun test test/plan-approval-gate.test.ts]

A test in test/plan-approval-gate.test.ts covers the approve-with-branch-failure path: it asserts the returned phase is not 'implementing' AND that notifyFn was invoked with the surfacing line. [oracle: bun test test/plan-approval-gate.test.ts]

The existing success-path test (approve -> proceedBranchFn success -> 'implementing') and the reject-path test still pass unchanged, and the resolver still never throws (best-effort/never-throw contract preserved: proceedBranchFn/removePrdFn/notifyFn wrapped so a partial failure never propagates out of the handler). [oracle: bun test test/plan-approval-gate.test.ts]

In src/commands/sidecar.ts, makePlanApprovalResolverDeps.proceedBranchFn reports failure (rather than success) when deriveBranchName returns null OR the git checkout-B/add/commit sequence does not leave the cam/* branch as HEAD, and it emits a durable event via the already-threaded logEvent on that failure path, while still swallowing every git error (never throws). [oracle: file-assert grep -q 'proceedBranchFn' src/commands/sidecar.ts]
pollAndResolveGate (src/supervisor/gate.ts) is NOT modified. [oracle: file-assert git diff --quiet main -- src/supervisor/gate.ts]

A test asserts the sidecar production proceedBranchFn reports failure on the git-failure/missing-branch case (real tmpdir git repo or DI-fake spawn at the wire boundary) and that it does not report success when no cam/* branch exists. [oracle: bun test test/sidecar-gate-phase.test.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint/static spine is green (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Files: src/supervisor/plan-approval-gate.ts (PlanApprovalResolverDeps.proceedBranchFn return type + makePlanApprovalResolver approve arm), src/commands/sidecar.ts (makePlanApprovalResolverDeps.proceedBranchFn: verify branch via e.g. `git -C cwd rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD` === derived branchName, log durable event on failure), test/plan-approval-gate.test.ts, test/sidecar-gate-phase.test.ts. This is an atomic type/contract change spanning the resolver module (producer of the interface) and its sole production consumer in sidecar.ts, so it stays one story to keep typecheck green (changing proceedBranchFn's signature ripples across both files + both tests simultaneously). deriveBranchName lives in src/supervisor/plan-runner.ts; notifyFn is makeNotifyOrchestrator (already best-effort, silent no-op on a closed pane); logEvent is the WorkerEventLogger from src/supervisor/events.ts already threaded into makePlanApprovalResolverDeps. GOTCHA (issue CAM-319 + code comment sidecar.ts:2744-2750): the never-throw contract is intentional and non-blocking; ADD observability (surface failure) WITHOUT reintroducing a throw and WITHOUT a second setPhase flip (pollAndResolveGate already flips phase to whatever the handler returns). noUncheckedIndexedAccess: guard any rev-parse output parse. Do not reuse executeGitProceedBranch (it throws on non-zero git exit and calls its own setPhaseFn). Source: cam/issue-312, review round 1.
